title: NFTMatrix
tagline: NFT Matrix lets you create Matrix agents to perform tasks. These unique AI agents can sign and send transactions, primarily managing their assets. With permanent memory, they evolve autonomously. As the Architect, you control asset swapping and set permissions for agent control.
description: NFT Matrix is a platform that enables you to create a force of Matrix agents to carry out various tasks for you. These agents are not ordinary AI agents; they were spawned dispersed and will never reveal their ultimate form. They possess the ability to sign and send transactions, with their primary function being the management of their individual assets. Each agent already has a permanent memory, allowing them to evolve as autonomous entities. As the Architect, you can direct them to swap their assets. Additionally, as the Architect, you have the authority to set permissions, determining who can control these agents.
how_its_made:
Programmable Key Pairs NFTs/PKPs by Lit Protocol: These unique NFTs serve as the foundation of the Matrix agents, allowing them to perform tasks like signing and sending transactions.
Uniswap SDK V3: We used the Uniswap SDK for asset swapping, which enables agents to manage their individual assets seamlessly.
Airstack: This tool helps us manage NFT Wallet assets.
Filecoin Storage helper, Lighthouse: This storage solution allows us to securely store each agent's chat history permanently, enhancing the agents' autonomous evolution.
GPT-3.5 model: We integrated the GPT-3.5 model for natural language processing and AI-driven communication for the time-being. The system is designed to allow switching to a local LLM if feasible.
